aim: Narrow: unsheath first (cheapest end-to-end check), then lock and trap, because Act already had Lockpick/Disarm bindings; teleport and improvised weapon time-boxed.
found: FINDINGS (14 recipes, reached_by cheat, evidence repeated; layouts NOT checked, existence+timing only): esv::lock::{LockpickingState,SteeringRequestOneFrame,ActiveRollRequestOneFrame,AnimationRequestOneFrame,SpendActionResourceRequestOneFrame,NotificationEventOneFrame} + esv::unsheath::LockPicking (lock picking, twice); esv::trap::{DisarmingState,SteeringRequestOneFrame,ActiveRollRequestOneFrame,AnimationRequestOneFrame,SpendActionResourceRequestOneFrame,NotificationEventOneFrame,DisarmResultEventOneFrame} (disarm, twice). Also newly recorded: eoc::lock::AnimationState/Lifetime, eoc::trap::DisarmingAnimationState (client), eoc::notification::LockpickedEvent, esv::action_resource::CooldownTracking. Unlocked-event extras seen: esv::lock::UnlockedEventOneFrame, StateChange. The lock request is the engine's own queue (GK.Stage.PickLock appends to Ext.System.ServerLockpicking.PickLockRequests) so the earlier 'no lockpicking in the API' is STALE: GK.Act.Lockpick/Disarm exist and work. LockpickingStateComponent (112 bytes, no layout): holds entity handles (likely character/target/tool, unconfirmed) and a float3 equal to the picker's position (54.02,17.66,-427.6) - lead only. bg3_verify esv::unsheath agreed on 1 layout (LockPicking). LEADS / NOT REACHED: esv::unsheath::UserRequest*, UserRequestFailed, Combining - the hotbar MeleeWeapon button and X/Z keys produce EquipmentChanged / RefreshAnimationSubSet / StateChangedEvent but NOT UserRequest (not caught by a per-tick count watcher either); the real draw/sheathe path is likely the radio MeleeToggle or a client task net message. esv::lock::NeedsValidation never seen. esv::teleport: Target_MistyStep taught by cheat but Astarion has no level-2 slot, blocked. esv::improvised_weapon: Throw_ImprovisedWeapon with an inventory potion and with a floor bottle ran (thrown::* seen) but no improvised_weapon one-frames - these probably need the world-object pick-up path (PickUpRequest is only read in code, writer unknown).
